title: Kissed Dense Kenyan Lamb Kebabs
description: A monsoon Kenyan dish featuring lamb kebabs marinated in umami flavors and marjoram, then deep-fried and served on a hot stone plate, this recipe is FODMAP friendly.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, marjoram, ginger, garlic infused oil, salt, and black pepper.
Add the lamb cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Let the lamb marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Preheat the agemono deep fryer to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Remove the lamb from the marinade and thread onto skewers.
Deep fry the lamb kebabs for 5 minutes or until cooked through.
Heat a hot stone plate in the oven at 400 degrees Fahrenheit for 10 minutes.
Place the deep fried lamb kebabs on the hot stone plate and brush with lemon juice.
